# PhysicsApplyForceAt 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsApplyForceAt:Void entity:Int32, x:Float32, y:Float32, z:Float32, px:Float32, py:Float32, pz:Float32, global:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `x` | In | Float32 | required | Along x (pitch for turning). |
| `y` | In | Float32 | required | Along y (yaw for turning). |
| `z` | In | Float32 | required | Along z (roll for turning). |
| `px` | In | Float32 | required |  |
| `py` | In | Float32 | required |  |
| `pz` | In | Float32 | required |  |
| `global` | In | Int32 | `0` | False (default): the numbers are in the space of the body. True: they are in the world. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Pushes a body with a force in newtons at a point of it, which also turns it. Works like `PhysicsApplyForce`.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
